title: Character Info : AION 2-NC (Baon, Fafnir)
note: Official global character page, client-rendered; read with agent-browser. Its network log shows the JSON endpoints it calls.
summaryEn: The official profile of Baon (Fafnir, EU, Asmodian Cleric, level 36): gear with enchant levels, skills and stigmas with levels, Daevanion boards, titles.

title: Official character search (global)
note: Unauthenticated JSON. region and localeInfo are required (400 without). Returns characterId, serverId, pcId, level per match.
summaryEn: Name search per region; the EU search lists Baon on Fafnir at level 36 with the Cleric pcId.

title: Official character info endpoint
note: Unauthenticated JSON: profile, stats (item level is a stat row), titles, ranking, Daevanion boards. 404 without region.
summaryEn: Profile (name, class, level, combat power, server), primary and deity stats with item level, titles and Daevanion board progress.

title: Official character equipment endpoint
note: Unauthenticated JSON: equipped gear, pet and wings, and the full skill list (Active, Passive, Dp = stigma) with levels and an equip flag.
summaryEn: Gear per slot with enchant and exceed levels, and every class skill with its level, acquired and equipped flags.

title: Official character pages' script bundle
note: Excerpts only: base hosts, the region and lang params, the search, info, equipment and Daevanion calls.
summaryEn: How the official pages build their API calls, global versus KR.

title: AION 2 Armory: Character Search & Gear Lookup | MetaBot.GG
note: Fan armory over the official data, copy refreshed when older than 30 minutes. No public API: /api/ is disallowed in robots.txt and answers curl with 403.
summaryEn: Says it reads the public character data the official site publishes; no documented API.

title: Terms of Use (NC, English)
note: Section 6 forbids accessing or searching the Services by automated means other than NC's published interfaces, and scraping without NC's consent.
summaryEn: NC's game terms: no automated access or scraping outside published interfaces without a separate agreement.
